Maryam Tahmasbi, daughter-in-law of a Madoumeh Ebtekar a U.S. embassy hostage-taker, living in America, enjoying freedom of choice, freedom of dress, freedom of everything.

On the other side:
Arezoo Badri, shot by morality police for refusing compulsory hijab, paralyzed from the waist down.

She attacked our campaign, White Wednesdays, and said: Masih wants to impose Western values on Iranians but Iranian women respect the hijab because the drug is our culture.

No.
Hypocrisy is yo

She laughs, nervously and claims her son is “just another student” like thousands of Iranians in America, and says he plans to go back.

That’s not just misleading. It’s a big lie because he stayed. He benefited. And he represents something very different.

یادت هست خانم گروگان‌گیر چقدر تحقیرم کردی!  رفته بودم اینجا ، جلوی سفارت سابق ایران ایستادم تا به تحقیرت پاسخ بدهم؛ وقتی گفتی:
«این دختره مسیح هر روز درباره پسرم دروغ می‌گه. پسرم مثل بقیه دانشجوها رفته آمریکا درس بخونه و برمی‌گرده ایران.»

خانم گروگان‌گیر،
پسرت برنگشت. او ماند در کشوری که تو شیطان بزرگ صدایش کردی و از دیوار سفارتش بالا رفتی و یک ملت را بدبخت

I’m glad that finally my voice, and the voice of millions of Iranians, has been heard here in the United States. You can’t cheer for hostage-takers and then apply for U.S. protection. That’s not asylum, that’s hypocrisy w

در همین توییتر و اینستاگرام، روایت رفاهِ برآمده از رانت را به تصویر کشیدم و بر اساس اصول حرفه‌ای و قوانین آمریکا به فرزندان مسولان نظام فرصت پاسخگویی دادم، که البته آنها حتی یک کلمه در محکومیت جنایت‌هایی

This Iranian woman explains how the Islamic Republic staged a mock executions for her, just because she sent herself walking unveiled. Yes they took her to the brink to force a false confession against me on TV. For those who think this regime can be reformed this is it still happening in 21st-century.

@mozhgankshavarz

#StopExecutionsInIran
#DigitalBlackout

There is no real ceasefire inside Iran.
This is Mohseni Ejei, the head of the judiciary.

در تلویزیون CBS تاکید کردم دستگاه سرکوب و کشتار در ایران نه تنها تضعیف نشده بلکه بقایای جمهوری اسلامی مثل یک حیوان زخمی، وحشی‌تر شده و ماشین اعدام‌شان را سرعت بخشیده‌اند. به مردم ایران خبر جعلی نباید داد، تغییر رژیمی صورت نگرفته، هرگونه مذاکره با چنین رژیمی بدون در نظر گرفتن این اعدام‌ها و قطعی اینترنت یعنی زمان دادن به بقایای رژیم تا این ماشین کشتار را برای انتقام بیشتر از مردم و کشورهای منطقه سرعت ببخشند.


Masih Alinejad 🏳️ (@AlinejadMasih)

My message to the U.S. government on CBS: stop talk

Heartbreaking moment, but powerful. 

Look at Kosar Eftekhari. The Islamic regime shot her eye out and blinded her during the Women, Life, Freedom revolution. Now she is in Germany, shocked that people there defend the same regime, the same IRGC. She’s asking them: Who are you defending? She shows them her eye, see what they did. Why defend them? 
I’ve known Kosar since she was a teenager in Iran, part of my #WhiteWednesdays campaign against forced hijab. She’s a hero, not a victim but here she

My message to the U.S. government on CBS: stop talking about a fake “regime change” in Iran.

Any negotiation that says nothing about executions, political prisoners, mass repression, and internet blackouts is not about the Iranian people. It’s about saving a regime that is killing them.

You call them “reasonable” and “less radical.”
We call them what they are: killers.

#Iran 
#DigitalBlackOutIran‌

Video

Many brilliant Iranian students came to the United States with nothing but their dreams, their talent, and their respect for the law. They believed in the promise of this country, a place where hard work, freedom, and merit matter.
Today, many of those same students and immigrants are living in fear and uncertainty because of the #USCISPause . These are people who followed every rule, respected every law, and have absolutely no connection to the Iranian regime. Yet their lives, their careers, an

This is for you president @realDonaldTrump! You call them “reasonable” we call them killers. 

You call it regime change, we call them terrorist .

Under Masoud Pezeshkian, a massacre took place in Iran.
Mohseni Ejei is still executing protesters, and Bagher Ghalibaf still controls a parliament that passes laws used to kill women for showing their.

This is not a regime change, this is called dictatorship.
